title: Stable Diffusion 1.5
description: The classic 512 px model: fast, runs on every Mac, thousands of LoRAs.

title: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
description: Newest FLUX generation, distilled to 4 steps. Best quality per GB of RAM.

title: Stable Diffusion 1.5 Inpainting
description: SD 1.5 trained to repaint masked parts (Inpainting page, AI Canvas).

title: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
description: Larger klein model, runs 8/4 bit on 16-24 GB Macs.

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein (MLX, 6 bit)
description: Black Forest Labs' newest model in 6 bit for the MLX runtime: text to image and edits with a reference picture, 16 steps, about 6 minutes per picture. Runs on 16 GB Macs; an optional prompt upsampler writes the full description.

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein (MLX, 8 bit)
description: FLUX 3 Image Klein in 8 bit for the MLX runtime, closest to Black Forest Labs' 16 bit files; fits 16 GB Macs too (the prompt is read before the model is loaded).

title: FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs, 16 bit)
description: Black Forest Labs' own 16 bit files of FLUX 3 Image Klein (only what the MLX runtime reads is downloaded). Needs the licence accepted on Hugging Face and an access token.

title: FLUX.1 [schnell] (4 bit)
description: 4-step FLUX.1, pre-quantized GGUF transformer. Text encoders and VAE come from the official repo.

title: FLUX.1 [schnell] (8 bit)
description: 4-step FLUX.1 with an 8 bit GGUF transformer, close to full quality.

title: FLUX.1 [dev] (16 bit)
description: Full FLUX.1 [dev]. On Macs with less than 24 GB its transformer streams from the SSD: slower, but it runs on 16 GB.

title: FLUX.1 [dev] (4 bit)
description: Guidance-distilled FLUX.1 for highest detail, pre-quantized GGUF transformer.

title: Chroma1-HD
description: Apache 2.0 model built from FLUX.1 [schnell] (8.9B): real guidance with a negative prompt, uncensored. Its transformer is quantized to 8 bit when it is loaded on Macs below 32 GB, and streams from the SSD below 20 GB.

title: Chroma1-Flash
description: The fast Chroma: distilled to 12 steps without guidance (one pass per step instead of two) – about 7 minutes per picture at 1024 px on an M2 with 24 GB, seven times quicker than Chroma with guidance. Apache 2.0, uncensored. Quantized to 8 bit below 32 GB, streams from the SSD below 20 GB.

title: Z-Image-Turbo
description: Tongyi-MAI's 6B model distilled to 8–9 steps without guidance: photorealistic pictures and legible text (English and Chinese) in few steps. Apache 2.0. About 5½ minutes per picture at 1024 px on an M2 with 24 GB with the MLX runtime (8 bit; 4 bit on 16 GB), about 6½ with Diffusers; image to image and inpainting run with Diffusers. LoRAs in ai-toolkit, ComfyUI and kohya names work. The official repository stores the transformer in 32 bit (24.6 GB of the download); it is computed in 8 or 16 bit.

title: ERNIE-Image-Turbo
description: Baidu's 8B model distilled to 8 steps: strong on text in pictures, posters, comics and multi-panel layouts. Runs on the MLX runtime (4 or 8 bit, text encoder included).

title: Wan 2.2 Image to Video (14B, 4 steps)

title: Wan 2.2 Image to Video (5B)
